detail: StoreHighWater.promote / promotionRecord (checks.ts, high-water.ts) have no production caller: nothing appends a 'this check passed on main' record when run-registered-checks.ts runs on main, so deriveTier's gating path is unreachable and no check can ratchet to gating even after its criterion is ratified (review finding on PR #3187, 2026-09-01, out of the claim's criteria). Owed: a main-only promotion append in the runner or CI, landing beside the ratchet flip. Never fixed by widening this claim.
